title: The Silly Mod
description: A Minecraft mod that adds lots of new silly things!
body:
# **The Silly Mod**
The Silly Mod is a Minecraft Mod that adds crazy, wacky, stupid but fun additions to the game.
The main focus of the mod is the Silly Dimension, where most of the mod passes. Right now, the current version of the mod is ALPHA.
There's new blocks, biomes, dimensions, mobs, bosses, recipes, items... and a little bit more!By the way, this is my first ever mod so expect some imperfections! Sorry!
# **How to go to the Silly Dimension:**
To enter the silly dimension, you must first, in the overworld, find a house. Inside this house, you'll find chest and inside these chests, you'll find some Silly Stone blocks and some other things! Ok, so, after you've went through many houses and gotten enough Silly Stone, you can now build a Silly Dimension portal frame! Its shape is identical to the Nether portal frame so don't worry! Ok so... yippee! Silly Dimension portal frame! What now? You must craft a Sad BSOD guy to activate the portal! How to craft it? With a Nether Star, some soulsand and... you'll find later! Heheh!
# **The rest of the information?:**
It's WAY better for you to find out by yourself.
